collision_boundary.C138: C138 uses flux winding in a metric quantum graph primitive-walk determinant, not Bloch-band winding or SSH edge hybridization.
collision_boundary.C267: C267 is an infinite uniform-field Wannier--Stark ladder with Bessel propagation, not a dimerized finite topological chain.
collision_boundary.C297: C297 is a two-site non-Hermitian PT dimer with an exceptional point, not a many-cell Hermitian bulk--edge system.
collision_boundary.C308: C308 is a one-site non-Hermitian nonreciprocal skin chain and explicitly excludes winding and topological edge modes; C318 is Hermitian, bipartite, chiral, and bulk--edge based.

model.clock: physical unitary time i psi_dot=H psi
model.hoppings: real v,w>=0 with v intracell and w intercell
model.open_size: M>=2 cells and 2M sites; M=1 is an explicit convention face

nonclaims: No literature-priority claim is made for the SSH model, winding, bulk--edge correspondence, or finite edge splitting.
The finite characteristic polynomial is not an Euler factor and the source spectrum is not a target zero set.
No disorder, interaction, self-consistent phonon, many-body DQPT, automorphy, root number, or Hilbert--Polya claim is made.

one_cell_convention.statement: the open intercell bond is absent; the periodic wrap bond merges with the intracell bond

references.role: soliton excitation and localized gap-state lineage

theorem_contract.bulk: winding of q(k)=v+w exp(ik) is one for w>v and zero for v>w; continuum and finite sampled gaps are distinguished
theorem_contract.faces: w=0 gives M dimers; v=0 gives M-1 dimers plus two exact edge zeros; both zero gives the zero matrix
theorem_contract.finite_edge: one hyperbolic pair exists iff w/v>(M+1)/M
theorem_contract.periodic_parity: at v=w>0 a finite ring has a two-dimensional zero sector iff M is even
theorem_contract.propagator: the entire block sinc formula is valid on every singular face
theorem_contract.quench: gapped opposite-phase Bloch quenches and only those have continuum mode Loschmidt zeros; finite rings require momentum-grid incidence
theorem_contract.threshold_separation: bulk critical ratio is one; the strict finite hyperbolic threshold is (M+1)/M
